# ============================================================
# 09 - 計算の成否を色分けカードで Teams にアラート
# ------------------------------------------------------------
# fincalc.exe の成否を Adaptive Card のスタイルで可視化する。
#   成功 → style:"good"（緑帯）の完了カード
#   失敗 → style:"attention"（赤帯）のエラーカード + stderr はログへ
# 使い方: 08 同様 WebhookUrl にワークフロー webhook の URL を入れる。
#   URL 中の % は %% にエスケープ。
# テスト用にわざと失敗させるなら --cost abc など不正引数にする。
# ============================================================
SET ExePath TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\fincalc.exe'''
SET WorkDir TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc'''
SET WebhookUrl TO $'''https://example.webhook.office.com/webhookb2/xxxxx'''
SET LogPath TO $'''C:\\work\\fincalc\\out\\flow.log'''


SET JobName TO $'''減価償却バッチ'''

# --- 実行 ---
# CLI を実行し stdout/stderr/exit code を CliOut/CliErr/CliExit へ格納
Scripting.RunDOSCommand.RunDOSCommand DOSCommandOrApplication: $'''%ExePath% dep schedule --method declining --cost 1000000 --life 10 --months 12''' WorkingDirectory: WorkDir StandardOutput=> CliOut StandardError=> CliErr ExitCode=> CliExit

DateTime.GetCurrentDateTime.Local DateTimeFormat: DateTime.DateTimeFormat.DateAndTime CurrentDateTime=> Now

# --- 成否でカードを切替（色帯 + FactSet） ---
IF CliExit = 0 THEN
    # stdout の JSON をカスタムオブジェクトへ変換
    Variables.ConvertJsonToCustomObject Json: CliOut CustomObject=> Result
    SET LastIndex TO Result.schedule.Count - 1
    SET LastYear TO Result.schedule[LastIndex]
    SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"[OK] %JobName% 完了","weight":"bolder","size":"medium"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"取得価額","value":"%Result.cost% 円"},{"title":"耐用年数","value":"%Result.usefulLifeYears% 年"},{"title":"償却方法","value":"%Result.method%"},{"title":"最終年償却費","value":"%LastYear.expense% 円"},{"title":"時刻","value":"%Now%"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"good","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"正常終了しました","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
ELSE
    # stderr は JSON 破壊文字を含み得るのでカードには入れずログへ
    # テキストを UTF8 でファイルへ追記 (ログ用)
    File.WriteText File: LogPath TextToWrite: $'''%Now% [ERROR] %JobName% exit=%CliExit% stderr=%CliErr%''' AppendNewLine: True IfFileExists: File.IfFileExists.Append Encoding: File.FileEncoding.UTF8
    SET Body TO $'''{"type":"message","attachments":[{"contentType":"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive","content":{"type":"AdaptiveCard","$schema":"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json","version":"1.4","body":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"[ERROR] %JobName% 失敗","weight":"bolder","size":"medium","color":"attention"},{"type":"FactSet","facts":[{"title":"終了コード","value":"%CliExit%"},{"title":"時刻","value":"%Now%"},{"title":"ログ","value":"out\\flow.log"}]},{"type":"Container","style":"attention","items":[{"type":"TextBlock","text":"詳細はログファイルを確認してください","wrap":true}]}]}}]}'''
END

# --- Webhook POST ---
# Teams Webhook へ Adaptive Card JSON を POST (応答は HTTP 202)
Web.InvokeWebService.InvokeWebService Url: WebhookUrl Method: Web.Method.Post Accept: $'''application/json''' ContentType: $'''application/json''' RequestBody: Body EncodeRequestBody: False TrimRequestBody: True ClearCookies: True FailOnErrorStatus: False FollowRedirection: True UserAgent: $'''Mozilla/5.0''' ConnectionTimeout: 30 AcceptUntrustedCertificates: False Response=> WebResponse ResponseHeaders=> WebHeaders StatusCode=> WebStatus

IF (WebStatus < 200) OR (WebStatus > 299) THEN
    # 警告ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''Teams 通知失敗''' Message: $'''HTTP %WebStatus% : %WebResponse%''' Icon: Display.Icon.Warning Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 30
    EXIT
END

# --- ローカルにも結果表示 ---
IF CliExit = 0 THEN
    # 情報ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''完了''' Message: $'''%JobName% 正常終了 → Teams 通知済み''' Icon: Display.Icon.Information Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 10
ELSE
    # 警告ダイアログを表示 (Timeout 秒で自動的に閉じる)
    Display.ShowMessageDialog.ShowMessageWithTimeout Title: $'''失敗''' Message: $'''%JobName% が失敗しました (exit=%CliExit%)。Teams にエラーカードを投稿済み''' Icon: Display.Icon.Warning Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False Timeout: 30
END
